physical_subject: Does a long unsuccessful wait change the remaining chance?
relationship: Independent fixed-p Bernoulli trials have P(T>m+n|T>m)=(1−p)^n. Without replacement changes the next-success probability.
operation: Failure factors cancel in a conditional probability; removing tokens supplies a contrasting stateful process.
closest_prior: Earlier coin pattern waiting and bus inspection paradox
substantive_difference: Memorylessness of first-success fixed-probability trials contrasted with sampling without replacement; not pattern-overlap waiting or length-biased observation.
